title: Experimental Photoshop collage
subject: As described in the prompt
reverse_engineered_prompt: Design an experimental fashion-editorial mixed-media collage centered on a dramatic studio portrait of a young adult model. Combine a clean photographic-style face and upper-body silhouette with overlapping paper textures, angled geometric panels, cut-out shapes, and layered editorial fragments. Use a sophisticated palette of muted lavender, plum, warm cream, and charcoal. Create deliberate depth through offset layers, crisp cut edges, subtle paper grain, and strong asymmetrical balance. Keep the face unobstructed and the composition visually coherent rather than cluttered. No existing brand marks, copied artwork, readable text, or watermark. 4:3 landscape composition.
